source_title: Homer Makes Achilles Real Enough To Invent The Human
summary: This Great Books #2 lecture is already public source support for Fictional Heroes, Stories, Human Heart, Poetry, and the atlas truth/prediction relation; its remaining impact is to keep Achilles, Homeric consciousness, speech-as-reality-fight, and poet-prophet truth routed to existing concept homes instead of spawning duplicate Homer or archetype pages.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Past, present, and future collide together on truth.

new_lens_seeds.title: Archetypes As Universal Memory
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Jiang explains literary aliveness by treating memory and emotion as partly nonlocal: the brain functions like an antenna, emotions inhabit wavelengths or dimensions, archetypes become accessible through universal consciousness, and the poet creates real characters by opening to that field.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism may compare Homer, Dante, Shakespeare, prophecy, Jungian archetypes, reincarnation, God/universe language, and Jiang's consciousness claims, but current public pages can carry it as Poetry/Fictional Heroes/Attention/Eschatology pressure without a standalone page.

chronology_notes.concept: How Fictional Heroes Become Part Of The Self
chronology_notes.note: Dated 2026-01-14, this lecture supplies the current public page's first Great Books mechanism: Achilles becomes real to the reader before the 2026-01-21 Poets and Prophets lecture generalizes the character-in-reader mechanism to tragedy and civilization.

The same 2026-01-14 lecture gives the already-public interpersonal speech-fight case before the 2026-01-21 Odysseus/Poets-and-Prophets lecture generalizes speech into world projection and shared language.

This source should remain the poetic-truth side of the atlas relation: prophet does not first mean fortune-teller here; truth is universe/God/past-present-future together, and only then can prediction appear as a test or moral judgment.

next_actions.action: No public Fictional Heroes, Stories, Human Heart, Poetry, or atlas append is needed now; the strongest mechanisms and lens-point links are already public or already linked from the episode read.

Do not create standalone Homer, Achilles, Olympian Achilles, Human Invention, Hear Yourself Speak, Universal Consciousness, Brain Antenna, Archetype, Prophet, Poet-Prophet-Teacher, or Truth Is Prediction pages from this source alone.

If public synthesis follows, prefer a Poetry/Fictional Heroes comparison note on archetypes, universal memory, and poet-prophet-teacher after comparing at least Homer #2, Poets and Prophets, Dante, Shakespeare, and consciousness/interview sources.

If provenance maintenance follows, only add missing links for exact marks: ghostly self-distance may need a future Fictional Heroes or Attention anchor, while brain-antenna/universal-consciousness should wait for an archetype/consciousness comparison decision.
